subject: REPOSITORY paragraph
notes: Rule (cite.py --check 12.3.8.3 'references to program-prototype-name-1 are to the named program definition and this program-specifier is ignored' -> OK §12.3.8.3 15)). Code: ProgramPrototypesOf registers every specifier, then OVERWRITES map[u.Name] with SelfPrototype(u) for every program in BinderDriver.ContainingDefinitions(unit) - the unit itself and each program containing it (kb/Work PB3121: §8.4.6.8's 'containing program definition' includes the element's own, so the self entry no longer waits on a written specifier) - so a self- or container-naming specifier (including its AS literal-3) is discarded and the reference activates the named definition by its own externalized name. Probe out/probe/repo/sr15.cob (--std 2023): PROGRAM-ID. SR15P RECURSIVE whose REPOSITORY writes 'PROGRAM SR15P AS "SR15OTH"', with a program SR15OTH in the group; CALL SR15P recurses into itself (DEPTH=1, DEPTH=2) and never reaches SR15OTH - correct. conformance:cases/12.3.8-REPOSITORY/l1c24_repository_self_program_specifier pins the written self specifier; conformance:cases/12.3.8-REPOSITORY/pb3121_containing_definition_scope pins the specifier-free self and container spellings the same overwrite serves.
